Privacy policy

How information is used in the branch-management and field-work apps.

Scope

This policy describes data handling in NIRAB CLEAN – Provider (نيراب كلين - المسؤول) and NIRAB CLEAN – Technician (نيراب كلين - الفني). Data processing varies by account role and the feature used. These are operational apps for branch management and service delivery.

Covered package names: com.nirab.provider and com.nirab.serviceman.

Data processed

  • Account and contact information: name, phone number, email, account identifiers, and branch, contact-person or address details when supplied.
  • Registration and verification: application information, identity-document type and number, and photos or documents you select for application or account verification where the feature requires them.
  • Bookings and work: requested services, appointments, booking status, staff assignments, execution checklists, work notes, evidence photos and related attachments.
  • Messages and files: messages, documents and images sent through conversations or service workflows.
  • Location: branch and service coordinates, and precise or approximate device location used with the relevant permission. See Location below.
  • Financial operations: provider bank-account, settlement or withdrawal information where available, and service collection amounts, payment methods, references and proof of collection.
  • Technical information: push notification tokens, installation identifiers and technical information needed by verification, messaging and mapping services.

Purposes

Data supports account management and verification, service and booking operations, staff assignment and work progress, communication between relevant parties, operational notifications, collections and settlements, support, account security and service disputes.

The provider and technician apps do not display commercial advertisements to their users. An advertising-management feature in the provider account, where available, manages material displayed in the customer app.

Location, media and permissions

Location permission is requested for relevant features, such as setting branch or service locations, navigation, and service arrival or completion verification. The technician app may send coordinates, accuracy and capture time for arrival or work-completion actions. It also periodically updates location while the relevant accepted booking screen is visible and the assignment is in an operational state such as on the way, arrived or ongoing. In the current release this periodic updating stops when the app goes into the background or the relevant screen closes.

The relevant customer may see the technician's location while the technician is on the way to the service. Authorized operational users may use it to follow the booking and estimate arrival. This feature is not intended to track movements outside the work context.

Camera, selected photos and files support profile, verification, work-evidence and conversation features. Device permissions can be managed in your device settings. A feature that needs a permission may be unavailable when permission is denied or withdrawn.

Recipients and service providers

Booking, contact and work information is made available as needed to authorized participants, such as platform or branch management, the assigned technician and the relevant customer. Access depends on roles, permissions and the service context.

The apps use services such as Firebase for notifications and, when enabled, phone verification, and Google services for maps or directions. Necessary information may also be processed by hosting, storage, messaging and financial-service providers used to operate the service. Their own privacy policies and service terms also apply.

Google Privacy Policy · Firebase privacy information

Information may be disclosed in response to binding lawful requests, to protect rights and security, or to address service-related claims.

Security and retention

The apps' primary API connections use HTTPS to transmit information to NIRAB CLEAN's server. Access is tied to account roles.

Retention depends on the account relationship, operational booking and settlement needs, and necessary security, fraud prevention, accounting, claims or legal obligations. Some records may remain after an account closes. Deletion can differ from account deactivation or removal from the visible interface. When a deletion request is handled, you may ask which records must be retained and why.

Choices and deletion requests

You can update information available through account settings, manage device permissions, and contact support to request access, correction, account closure or deletion. We verify that a request relates to the account before carrying out an action intended to protect its owner's data.

An in-app deletion option may be available to some provider accounts depending on configuration, active work and settlement status. If no option is available, or you cannot sign in, use the public request page below. Uninstalling the app does not by itself delete an account.

Request account and data deletion

A request may require handling outstanding work or settlements and identifying records that must be retained for legitimate reasons. Do not email your password, verification codes or sensitive identity-document images to start a request.

Audience and policy updates

These operational apps are intended for authorized branch-management and field-work users; they are not designed as services directed at children. This policy may be updated when features or data practices change. The current policy will be available on this page.
